payload.note: DKR-2 replay latency probe: read US-028 spec write/read path sections; building python3 prototype (JSONL event log + SQLite cache + watermark) to measure per-mutation p95 and cold-start costs at 1k/10k/100k events.

Measurements done. Naive watermark p95: 1.1ms@1k, 4.7ms@10k (acceptance target, ~20x margin), 54ms@100k (max 67ms). Dominant cost = full re-read+re-hash of whole log on every command (linear in log bytes). fsync negligible even with F_FULLFSYNC (+~3ms). stat(size+mtime) short-circuit mitigation makes no-op check ~0.004ms flat at any size. Verdict: naive meets 100ms wall through 100k but scales linearly; cheap mitigation removes scaling. Writing final checkpoint.
